This week at a glance

  • Star Trek Ascendancy: Final Frontier (Oct 5): Gamefound update 48 unboxes a finished Deluxe All-In copy. GF9 says pledges will be “on the water” to distribution centers imminently.
  • Star Wars: Imperial Assault (checked Oct 5): Core Set and Tyrants of Lothal can be ordered again at Asmodee USA. No official out-of-print notice exists, and FFG’s first Vault title is Arkham Horror, not Imperial Assault.
  • LOTR: Fate of the Fellowship (checked Oct 5): Back in stock at Asmodee USA for $79.99.
  • Dune: Imperium (Oct 1): Digital edition 35% off in the Steam Autumn Sale through Oct 8.
  • StarCraft TMG (Oct 1): First Wave 2 reviews are up. Waves 3 and 4 still have no official pre-order dates.
  • Blood Rage (Sept 25 / checked Oct 5): U.S. Valhalla backers have their copies. The Road to Helheim expansion is on U.S. pre-order with an estimated Nov 30 release.
  • Special watch: Marvel Legendary What If…? Season 2: No change. There is no official status update and no official discontinuation notice.

Star Trek Ascendancy: Final Frontier

Gale Force Nine · Gamefound campaign / all-in collection

Update 48 “Unboxing! Shipping Imminent!”: Deluxe All-In copy unboxed; pledges about to ship by sea

Update Oct 5, 2026 (7:00 AM ET) New this week

GF9’s New Zealand studio got a finished Deluxe All-In copy of The Final Frontier and posted an unboxing video plus photos. The photos cover the Game and Civilization boxes, rulebooks, pop-outs, component trays, space lanes, wrapped cards, planet discs, Starbases, and each civilization’s pieces: Borg, Federation, Klingon, Romulan, Gorn, Tholian, Terran, Dominion, Vulcan, Ferengi, Breen, Andorian, and Cardassian.

GF9 says its production partners are “putting the finishing touches to everything” and expects all pledges to be “on the water and on the way to distribution centers imminently.” It says that keeps the campaign within the timeline from its early-August update (goods reach distributors in Q4 2026; backer fulfillment likely early Q1 2027). The next update will show photos of the containers being loaded and is promised “much sooner rather than later.” This is the factory-exit news the Aug 28 post had promised for September.

Sources: Gamefound update 48 (Oct 5) · Aug 6 timeline (update 44) · Campaign page

Production Update: August 2026 (Week 4) — plastic Starbases; factory exit expected September

Update Aug 28, 2026 Older · still relevant

GF9’s Week 4 August update closed the weekly plastics series with photos of new full-color plastic Starbases for the existing civilizations (Federation, Klingon, Romulan, Ferengi, Andorian, Cardassian, Breen, Dominion). Production was described as still on pace with the earlier August timeline (factory-to-distributor start in Q3; distributors in Q4 2026; backer fulfillment likely early Q1 2027). GF9 said the next bulletin would come in September once goods leave the factory for distribution hubs—hoped within a couple of weeks of the update, possibly sliding toward late September—after which more concrete regional fulfillment dates would follow. The promised follow-up came on Oct 5 as update 48 (above), a few days after the September target.

Sources: Gamefound Week 4 (Aug 28) · Aug 6 timeline · Campaign page

Production Update: August 2026 (Week 3) — Gorn plastics and printed Civilization Box

Update Aug 21, 2026 Older · still relevant

Week 3 showcased advance Gorn civilization plastics photographed at GF9’s New Zealand studio and gave a first look at the fully printed Civilization Box (Borg Cube–styled packaging). GF9 said production remained on pace with the August timeline and previewed that the following week would cover plastic Starbases.

Source: Gamefound Week 3 (Aug 21)

Star Wars: Imperial Assault

Miniatures / campaign · Fantasy Flight Games / Asmodee

Print status: Core Set and Tyrants of Lothal can be ordered again at Asmodee USA; no official out-of-print notice

Checked Oct 5, 2026 New this week

On Oct 5, 2026, Asmodee USA’s page for the Imperial Assault Core Set (SWI01, $119.99) had a working Add to cart button. So did the page for the Tyrants of Lothal campaign expansion. The Oct 2 report had both listed as sold out. Asmodee UK also lists the core (FFGSWI01, RRP £109.99) as available.

Print status: no FFG or Asmodee source checked this week says Imperial Assault is out of print or discontinued. The FFG product page, last updated Sept 23–24, does not label the core “Out of Print.” FFG’s Sept 22 “Kicking Off Crowdfunding” post names Arkham Horror: Remastered (Arkham Horror 2nd Edition) as the first title in its Vault Series, with a Gamefound campaign starting Oct 21. That post does not mention Imperial Assault, so Vault speculation about the game is still unconfirmed.

Sources: Asmodee USA Core Set · Asmodee USA Tyrants of Lothal · Asmodee UK · FFG product hub · FFG “Kicking Off Crowdfunding” (Sept 22)

Asmodee Deutschland announced a core-set reprint (expected Feb 2026)

Announced Nov 27, 2025 · expected ~Feb 2026 Older · still relevant

Asmodee Deutschland published an official notice that Star Wars: Imperial Assault would return to the German market as a reprint of the Fantasy Flight Games miniatures/campaign game, with an expected release around February 2026 and preorders directed to local retailers. The notice describes the same three modes (campaign, skirmish, and app-supported co-op) and does not announce new expansions or a revised edition. That expected window has passed; confirm current German retail stock rather than assuming the reprint is still inbound. A separate English-language Asmodee USA / FFG “reprint launch” post for the U.S. market was not found for this report.

Sources: Asmodee Deutschland (Nov 27, 2025) · Friday Knight summary (Jan 14, 2026)

No new content; line complete since Tyrants of Lothal

Last big-box wave ~2018 · status watch Older · context

Imperial Assault’s published line ends with the Tyrants of Lothal expansion wave (core campaign boxes through Heart of the Empire / Tyrants of Lothal plus ally and villain packs). FFG’s recent news rail on the product hub still points at older Organized Play / Legends of the Alliance items rather than 2025–2026 product launches. For collectors: treat core availability as intermittent reprint/stock rotation (DE reprint notice above; Asmodee USA showed core and Tyrants of Lothal orderable on Oct 5), and treat many figure packs as scarce or historically OOP unless a live retailer listing shows otherwise.

Sources: FFG hub / recent news rail · Asmodee USA Tyrants of Lothal · BGG reprint discussion (community; not official)

Dune Imperium

Dire Wolf · Imperium / Uprising / Immortality and related expansions

Dune: Imperium Digital 35% off in Steam Autumn Sale (Oct 1–8)

Oct 1, 2026 · sale runs Oct 1–8 New this week

Dire Wolf has discounted its digital board games on Steam and mobile from Oct 1 to Oct 8. Dune: Imperium Digital is 35% off. DLC discounts apply only on Steam, though DLC is cross-platform once bought. The Dune: Imperium Digital Bundle (base game plus Rise of Ix and Immortality) takes another 10% off on top of the sale prices. You can’t buy the bundle if you already own any item in it.

Source: Dire Wolf Digital (Oct 1)

Digital 4.1.0 adds online Reputation system (Sept 30)

Sept 30, 2026 This window

Dire Wolf shipped Dune: Imperium Digital patch 4.1.0 with a Reputation system aimed at early leavers: players start at 30 Rep, gain Rep for finishing games (wins not required), lose Rep for leaving early, and can set lobby minimums. Rep below 0 blocks Ranked until rebuilt. The patch also includes gameplay, UI, mobile, and achievement fixes.

Source: Dire Wolf Digital

Conspiracy expansion on Q4 2026 retail track; US preorders listing ~Oct 31–Nov 15

Announced Aug 24, 2026 Older · active preorders

ICv2 reported Dire Wolf’s Conspiracy expansion for Q4 2026 retail. It is compatible with both Dune: Imperium and Uprising, adding lasting Conspiracy cards, planet raids, Imperial Edicts, and asymmetric Overthrow Mode (one Emperor vs. two or three opponents). GameNerdz lists an expected release of Oct 31, 2026 at $40 (SKU DWD01024); Atomic Empire lists Nov 15, 2026. Both dates were unchanged on Oct 5 and may still move.

Sources: ICv2 · GameNerdz · Atomic Empire

StarCraft Miniatures Game

Wave 2 reaching players: first reviews; Waves 3–4 still have no official dates

Oct 1, 2026 · official shop checked Oct 5 New this week

The fan site Only Wargames Fans said on Oct 1 that “Wave 2 of StarCraft TMG is now available.” It posted a review and video, made with HiigyTV, of the rules for the Siege Tank, Immortal, Zeratul, and Ravager, along with sprues and painted models. The newest post on the official StarCraft TMG and Archon news pages is still the Aug 28 Wave 2 pre-order announcement. Neither later wave has an official pre-order date yet.

Sources: Only Wargames Fans (Oct 1) · StarCraft TMG shop · Archon Studio blog · Wargamer roadmap

Pre-launch coverage noted thousands of Kickstarter followers ahead of go-live.

2026 company update: Digital in Alpha (early 2027 target); Nexus next; accessory changes

Sept 24, 2026 This window

Dice Throne’s Sept 24, 2026 TL;DR update says Vanguard fulfilled faster than prior campaigns, retail and Organized Play continue to grow, and Dice Throne Digital is in Alpha with an early 2027 target. Product-policy changes include Accessory Packs dropping to $19.99 (sleeves, acrylic tokens, mini-sculpt only), Randomizer Cards shipping with every Hero, and Mythics shifting from hero-specific to game-specific for future Adventures/Missions (existing Mythics unchanged).

Star Trek: Captain's Chair

Asymmetric deckbuilding · WizKids · David Turczi & Nigel Buckle

No new news this week. Nothing newer than the Sept 29 Coqui Hobby listing. On Oct 5 the WizKids shop still had Resistance is Futile (pre-order) and To Boldly Go at $59.99. The August vs. November 2027 date conflict for Duty and Honor is still unresolved.

Resistance is Futile and Duty and Honor announced; retail timing disagrees

Retail target: August 2027 (ICv2) · WizKids shop: Q3 2027 Upcoming

WizKids opened pre-orders for two 2027 Captain’s Chair boxes. Resistance is Futile (ICv2: $59.99; Coqui Hobby item code WZK87655) is a standalone 1–2 player game, ages 14+, 60–120 minutes, with Captain Janeway, Seven of Nine, Locutus, and the Borg Queen, plus the U.S.S. Voyager and a Borg Cube. Duty and Honor ($39.99; Coqui WZK87656) is an expansion adding Worf, Gul Dukat, and two captains WizKids has not named, plus ships including the Val Jean and the U.S.S. Defiant. It requires the original Captain’s Chair, To Boldly Go, or Resistance is Futile. ICv2 (Sept 9) and Coqui Hobby (Sept 29) both say August 2027 retail. WizKids’ own shop, checked Oct 3, 2026, lists both as pre-orders with estimated release Q3 2027 ($59.99 and $39.99) and says pre-order dates can change. ScreenRant (Sept 20), citing CW, instead dates Duty and Honor to November 2027 while keeping Resistance is Futile in Q3 2027. Treat August vs. November as unresolved until WizKids publishes a day-level street date.

Sources: ICv2 (Sept 9) · Coqui Hobby (Sept 29) · WizKids Resistance is Futile · WizKids Duty and Honor · ScreenRant (Sept 20) · Backseat Gamer (Sept 12)

To Boldly Go standalone is on the WizKids shop at $59.99

Checked Oct 3, 2026 · publisher date Jul 15, 2026 This window

To Boldly Go is a fully standalone 1–2 player set (ages 14+, about 60–120 minutes) with solo play and six asymmetric captain decks. Publisher copy names Kirk, Khan (Asmodee UK spells it “Kahn”), Philippa Georgiou from Discovery, and Rebner, the Pakled commander from Lower Decks, and says the box has six captains total. Asmodee UK lists a publisher release date of July 15, 2026 (RRP £59.99). On Oct 3, 2026 the WizKids U.S. shop showed an Add to cart button at $59.99 rather than a pre-order hold. Earlier July coverage had described a July ship window with some channels back-ordered; confirm local stock.

Sources: WizKids shop (checked Oct 3) · Asmodee UK (Jul 15, 2026) · Bleeding Cool (Jul 25) · ScreenRant (Jul 16)

Second Contact expansion ($29.99) adds Pike, Freeman, and Krulmuth-B

Checked Oct 3, 2026 This window

Second Contact is an expansion, not a standalone. WizKids states it requires Star Trek: Captain’s Chair or To Boldly Go (the shop page does not list Resistance is Futile as a host). It adds Carol Freeman of the U.S.S. Cerritos, Christopher Pike, and at least one more captain (“and more”; the contents list three crew boards), plus Krulmuth-B as a starting location. Listed contents include 99 standard cards, 9 ship tokens, and 6 automated command cards. On Oct 3, 2026 the WizKids shop showed Add to cart at $29.99. The original Captain’s Chair (Picard, Sisko, Michael Burnham, Koloth, Sela, Thy’lek Shran) was also Add to cart at $59.99 the same day.

Sources: WizKids Second Contact · WizKids base game · Backseat Gamer

Blood Rage

Area control · Tycoon Games (Godly series; formerly CMON)

Valhalla fulfillment: U.S. backers done; Canada, Europe, Australia shipping; UK in weeks

Update Sept 25, 2026 This window

Tycoon’s Sept 25 “Mid Fulfillment Update” (Gamefound update 31) says U.S. fulfillment of Blood Rage: Valhalla is finished. Shipments are going out to backers in Canada, Europe/rest of world, and Australia. UK fulfillment should finish “within the next couple of weeks,” and China is still preparing. This follows the Sept 7 update saying the game was ready to ship.

The same post teases a new Gamefound campaign from “the creators of Blood Rage”: Rage of the Feathered Serpent, based on Mesoamerican mythology. So far there is only a page to follow, with no date or price.

Sources: Gamefound update 31 (Sept 25) · Gamefound update 30 (Sept 7)

Road to Helheim expansion for Valhalla on U.S. pre-order (est. Nov 30)

Retailer est. release: Nov 30, 2026 · checked Oct 5 Upcoming

U.S. retailer Cardhaus lists Blood Rage: Valhalla – Road to Helheim (Tycoon Games; 3–5 players, ages 14+, 60+ minutes) as a pre-order with an estimated release of Nov 30, 2026. According to the listing, it adds the Ram Clan faction with new miniatures, 12 new monsters, and three new gods. Their mechanics are Heimdall’s foresight, Hel’s power to raise the dead, and Odin’s multi-purpose Decrees. Tycoon has not published a retail date on its own channels, so treat this as a retailer estimate.

Sources: Cardhaus listing · BGG entry

Tycoon Games’ remastered Blood Rage: 2nd Edition folds the formerly exclusive Stag Clan and five-player support into the core box. UK retailer Gathering Games lists an estimated release of October 9, 2026 (£101.99); U.S. specialty shop Top Dawg Games lists a pre-order release date of November 15, 2026. Asmodee UK also carries a Blood Rage: 2nd Edition listing (RRP £124.99). Treat channel dates as estimates until stock appears.

Blood Rage: Valhalla selling direct from Tycoon ($125)

Eric Lang’s standalone sequel Blood Rage: Valhalla (3–5 players) is listed In stock on Tycoon Games’ store at $125.00. Base game still in Asmodee catalog (Bauza & Cathala two-player)

Release: Oct 2024 (Repos / Asmodee) Older, still relevant

The Lord of the Rings: Duel for Middle-earth is the Repos Production two-player game from Antoine Bauza and Bruno Cathala. Allies expansion in retail since October 24, 2025

Retail: Oct 24, 2025 Older, still relevant

Repos / Asmodee’s Allies mini-expansion for Duel for Middle-earth reached retail on October 24, 2025 (ICv2). Each side gains Ally cards (7 Fellowship / 7 Sauron) plus Power tokens and player aids; players start with secret Allies and spend tokens for enter/exit effects. Requires the base game. Repos press materials describe 14 Vincent Dutrait-illustrated Ally cards and 8 Power tokens.

Rebel & Empire Reinforcements Expansion in retail since July 24

Released Jul 24, 2026 Older · still in market

FFG/Asmodee’s Rebel & Empire Reinforcements Expansion (SWG04, $34.99) reached U.S. retail on July 24, 2026 and remains listed available at Asmodee USA and local retailers (select markets). The 140-card expansion for the original Rebel vs. Empire edition adds mission cards that unlock set-aside reinforcements (Yoda, R2-D2, Emperor Palpatine, Admiral Thrawn, Home One, Executor, and more), new bases, upgraded starter cards, and three new modes including a five-part campaign. Requires the original edition (SWG01); not compatible as a standalone with Clone Wars Edition alone.

Sources: FFG Available Now · FFG announcement (Apr 23) · Asmodee USA · ICv2

Designer diaries: missions and Upgraded Starter Mode

Jul 9 & May 14, 2026 Older · design context

Lead designer Caleb Grace detailed how mission cards let each faction earn 25 reinforcements without bloating the galaxy deck (Mission Briefing, May 14), and how campaign scoring led to an optional Upgraded Starter Mode that swaps in stronger starter cards and higher-HP mission-linked bases for a more aggressive one-off game (A Fresh Start, Jul 9). No newer product announcement for the line appeared between late July and this Oct 5 search.

Sources: A Fresh Start (FFG) · Mission Briefing (FFG) · FFG tag feed

Mandalorian Faction Pack still the live fifth-faction add-on

Released Nov 28, 2025 Older · product line context

The Mandalorian Faction Pack (SWG03) shipped November 28, 2025 and remains the line’s faction add-on: base/starter/galaxy cards for a fifth playable faction plus rules and neutrals for a three-player free-for-all. It requires either the original or Clone Wars Edition core. Together with Reinforcements (original-edition expansion) and Clone Wars Edition, it is the current published footprint—no core reprints or further packs were newly announced through Oct 5.

Sources: FFG announcement · FFG Available Now (Nov 28) · FFG product page (SWG04)

What If…? Season 2 status watch: no change, and no official discontinuation notice

Retailer dates cited ~mid-2026 · rechecked Oct 5 Older, still relevant

Distributor and retailer listings for Legendary What If…? Season 2 (UDE81752 / UD81752) still describe a ~100-card expansion continuing the Marvel Studios What If…? line (Kahhori, Happy “The Freak” Hogan, Avengers Across Time, keywords such as Reshape and Showoff). Some mid-2026 expected-ship dates on those listings have now passed without a matching Upper Deck “available now” announcement. Oct 5 recheck: nothing has changed since the last report. Canadian retailer Hobbiesville still lists the expansion as “available for Pre Order” ($26.95). Upper Deck’s news feed (newest post Oct 1) has no What If…? Season 2 announcement, delay notice, or cancellation notice.

Core Set Second Edition released June 17 with Miles Morales and Doc Ock

Release: June 17, 2026 Older, still relevant

Upper Deck’s Legendary: A Marvel Deck Building Game Second Edition (distributor code UDC99110) shipped June 17, 2026 as a redesigned core—not a reprint. The set grows to 550 playable cards (~250 reworked), adds Doctor Octopus as a Mastermind with the Sinister Syndicate Villain Group, and puts Spider-Man (Miles Morales) in the core in place of Deadpool. Masterminds are double-sided (normal/Epic), Schemes go to nine, Bystanders to 42, and 4–5 player games gain a Warmup Round. Full-bleed original art on every card; compatible with the existing Marvel Legendary expansion library. Street price listings cluster around $99.95.

Sources: Upper Deck What’s New · Upper Deck product hub · ICv2 (Feb 6) · Backseat Gamer · LegendaryCardGame expansions
